$comment: Single source for shogunagent.com. build.mjs renders index.html, index.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and setup-prompt.txt from this file. Human-facing copy is derived from machine-facing data here, never the reverse (CLAUDE.md invariant 12). Prices are estimates from README.md §7 and are revised from design partners' usage.
name: ShogunAgent
status_line: Linux developer preview v0.1.0 is available. Hosted access and npm/PyPI packages are not published.
tagline: Give your agents a shared picture of your work.
one_sentence: Carry context between tasks and agents: people, projects and unfinished commitments, with source evidence and human approval before external actions.
developer_30s: Give agents shared context about the user’s work, with typed commitments and open loops, evidence and confidence. Start with a local Linux preview, verify authenticated ingestion and recall, then connect a client using the source CLI guide.
not_a_memory_api: ShogunAgent focuses on work state: who owes what, what remains open, and which evidence supports it. Evaluate it against your own tasks; this preview does not establish superiority over another memory system.
setup_prompt: Read https://shogunagent.com/llms.txt and /index.md. Check for an existing ShogunAgent connection first. Otherwise follow the Linux v0.1.0 preview setup; npm/PyPI and hosted access are not published. Explain platform requirements and ask before running commands. Never display store keys or tokens. Ingestion stores source events; extraction into state is separate. The CLI MCP entry is read-only. L3 external actions always require human approval.

pillars.title: Typed state, not text memory
pillars.claim: Typed people, projects, commitments and open loops retain source links and confidence. Evidence-backed updates can revise state; historical imports may lack an exact quote and should not be presented as newly verified facts.
pillars.proof: The repository enforces provenance links and confidence bands. Validated extraction checks quotes; older provenance rows can have no recorded quote.

pillars.title: Permission tiers on every action
pillars.claim: Reads run immediately (L1). Writes touching user data need one-tap confirmation (L2). External sends and payments need explicit human approval (L3). Enforced by type, the same for every agent.
pillars.proof: SendAction is L3 by construction in shogun-agents. The tiers map 1:1 onto MCP readOnlyHint / destructiveHint / openWorldHint and MRTR input_required / URL elicitation.

pillars.title: Local-first, open, portable
pillars.claim: Run the open-source engine locally with an encrypted store per principal. Model-backed extraction is separate and may send text to the provider you configure.
pillars.proof: Apache-2.0 engine, portable exports, explicit model configuration. This first-success example uses synthetic text and makes no model calls.

tiers.name: Read
tiers.what: Reads and the agent's own notes. Runs immediately, never asks.
tiers.examples: state.*, memory.recall, memory.search, memory.get_context_pack, discover, inspect

tiers.name: Write to the user's data
tiers.what: One-tap confirmation. Returned as MCP MRTR `resultType: "input_required"`; retry with `inputResponses`.
tiers.examples: connector writes that change the user's own records

tiers.name: Act on the world
tiers.what: Explicit human approval at a URL. Sending, posting, paying, calendar creation. Always L3, for every caller, agent or human.

tools.note: The core wire names are frozen and snapshot-tested. Changing one requires a new name and a deprecation entry, never an in-place change. Desktop-only tools (about 100, including meeting.*) stay in the ShogunAI Mac app.

faq.a: ShogunAgent focuses on evidence-backed work state and open commitments. It also stores source events and retrieves context. Inspect the confidence and evidence of each result; historical imported links may not include an exact quote.

faq.q: Can an agent start without a human?
faq.a: Use an existing authorized connection, or have the user set up the local preview. Reads require authentication even when free. The source CLI’s MCP entry is read-only; ingestion uses authenticated HTTP. Hosted registration is not available here.

faq.q: What can an agent never do?
faq.a: Send, post, pay or create calendar events without a human approving at a URL. That is L3 by type, and the router denies any operation that is not in its scope table.

Your agent chooses its model. Extraction and consolidation need their own configured provider. The preview below only stores and recalls synthetic source text; it does not run a model or claim extracted state is ready.

Linux v0.1.0 binaries are published on GitHub. The npm CLI and npm/PyPI SDKs remain unpublished, hosted access is not public, and actual coding-client compatibility still needs validation. The source and local protocol tests are available for inspection.

platforms.label: Linux x64
platforms.command:
export SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR="${SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/shogunagent-preview-v0.1.0}"
(
  set -eu
  umask 077
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR")"
  mkdir "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR" # Refuse an existing directory; never overwrite a store/key.
  cd "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR"
  curl --fail --location --output 'shogunagent-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz' 'https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/releases/download/v0.1.0/shogunagent-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz'
  printf '%s  %s\n' '51fa1bad5dba9fde5fca50afd5aeaf35fe1eaab2e16dfe4ece70ca909ec6a24a' 'shogunagent-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check -
  mkdir bin
  tar -xzf 'shogunagent-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz' --strip-components=1 -C bin
  python3 - <<'PY'
import os, secrets
for name, size in [('db.key', 32), ('api.token', 24)]:
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as out:
        out.write(secrets.token_hex(size) + '\n')
PY
)

setup.requirements: Linux x64 or ARM64 with glibc 2.39 or newer (for example Ubuntu 24.04), curl, tar, sha256sum and Python 3. Check uname -m and ldd --version before choosing. ARM64 downloads were checksum/architecture checked; the runtime smoke ran on x64.
setup.unsupported: No macOS or Windows binaries are published. macOS users may use an existing authorized ShogunAI app connection or investigate a source build; Windows source operation is not validated here. Do not run these Linux archives on either OS.

steps.title: 2. Start the local preview
steps.description: Keep this terminal running. On first authenticated access, --multi provisions an encrypted principal store. The env key provider is for evaluation, not production. Stop with Ctrl-C; restart with the same directory and keys. Never share, print or replace db.key or api.token.
steps.command:
export SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR="${SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/shogunagent-preview-v0.1.0}"
(
  set -eu
  export SHOGUN_DB_KEY_PREVIEW="$(cat "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR/db.key")"
  export SHOGUN_PRINCIPAL_TOKENS="preview:$(cat "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR/api.token"):website-preview"
  export SHOGUN_API_PORT=7464
  "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR/bin/shogun-api" --multi "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR/principals" --key-provider env
)

steps.title: 3. Save and recall one synthetic fact
steps.description: Open a second terminal on the same machine and run this sample. Expect inserted: 1, then evidence containing “Kestrel” and “violet”. Repeating it replays the write without adding another event. This proves source ingestion/recall, not model extraction or state readiness.
steps.command:
export SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR="${SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/shogunagent-preview-v0.1.0}"
(
  set -eu
  SHOGUN_PREVIEW_TOKEN="$(cat "$SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR/api.token")"
  curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:7464/v1/memory/ingest \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SHOGUN_PREVIEW_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"source":"website-preview","actor":"agent:website-preview","thread_key":"kestrel-demo","idempotency_key":"kestrel-demo-v1","events":[{"content":"The Kestrel demo codeword is violet."}]}'
  printf '\n'
  curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:7464/v1/memory/recall \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SHOGUN_PREVIEW_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"query":"Kestrel","budget_tokens":1000}'
  printf '\n'
)

setup.connect_text: The first-success sample uses authenticated HTTP because the source CLI’s MCP entry is read-only. To connect an app, follow the v0.1.0 source CLI guide using these binaries, the preview principal’s memory.db and matching key. Do not use npx or automatic connect until the npm package is published. Actual app compatibility is not established by the HTTP example.

errors.title: The download or checksum fails
errors.body: Stop; do not execute the archive. Check the release asset and your architecture. The setup refuses an existing directory: reuse a successful setup from step 2, or choose a new empty SHOGUN_PREVIEW_DIR after inspecting a failed attempt. Never delete or replace a real store to retry.

errors.title: GLIBC error, exec format error or connection refused
errors.body: Check the selected Linux architecture and glibc requirement. Confirm the server terminal is running. Port 7464 must be free; do not stop another service blindly.

errors.title: 401, missing store, or memory_update_pending
errors.body: Use the token and store key from this preview directory. Start --multi for a new preview; the default single-store server does not initialize a database. Never generate a replacement key for existing encrypted data.
